provenance: Fixed reference programs reviewed against the existing example texts. Rules output was used as an initial draft; this file is independent of reader predictions and is not training data.

star.text: Draw a huge gold star in the center.
star.sop: @s1 command action=create shape=star size=huge color=gold position=center

traffic.text: Draw a large red circle named Stop at the top.
traffic.sop: @s1 command action=create shape=circle size=large color=red name=Stop position=top

traffic.text: Put a large yellow circle named Wait below Stop, then put a large green circle named Go below Wait.
traffic.sop:
@s1 command action=create shape=circle size=large color=yellow name=Wait position=below anchor=Stop
@s2 command action=create shape=circle size=large color=green name=Go position=below anchor=$s1

traffic.text: Connect Stop to Wait with a plain line. Connect Wait to Go with a plain line.
traffic.sop:
@s1 command action=connect from=Stop to=Wait arrow=none
@s2 command action=connect from=Wait to=Go arrow=none

zoo.sop:
@m1 mention quantifier=all
@s1 command action=arrange target=$m1 layout=row

login.text: Draw a blue circle named Begin on the left, labeled "start".
login.sop: @s1 command action=create shape=circle color=blue name=Begin label=start position=left

login.text: Add a rectangle named Form to the right of Begin labeled "Enter password" and connect Begin to it.
login.sop:
@s1 command action=create shape=rectangle name=Form label="Enter password" position=rightOf anchor=Begin
@s2 command action=connect from=Begin to=$s1

login.text: Add a yellow diamond named Valid right of Form labeled "valid?" and connect Form to it.

@s1 command action=create shape=diamond color=yellow name=Valid label="valid?" position=rightOf anchor=Form

@s1 command action=create shape=rectangle color=green name=Home label=Dashboard position=rightOf anchor=Valid
@s2 command action=connect label=yes from=Valid to=$s1

login.text: Put a red rectangle named Error below Valid labeled "Show error". Connect Valid to Error with a dashed arrow labeled "no".

@s1 command action=create shape=rectangle color=red name=Error label="Show error" position=below anchor=Valid
@s2 command action=connect label=no from=Valid to=$s1 style=dashed

login.text: Connect Error to Form with a dotted arrow labeled "retry".
login.sop: @s1 command action=connect label=retry from=Error to=Form style=dotted

login.text: Is there a path from Begin to Home?
